1-8.notes: Starts with a hand-and-finger splitter, then hanging corners, a slab crux and the exposed horizontal crack traverse on pitch 3. A striking corner crack and a thin slab traverse follow, then finger cracks left into a corner system. Upper pitches can be dirty with moss and loose rock.

review.changed: Wrote the single combined 1-8 box from the pitch table: splitter start, pitch 3 traverse, corner/slab sections, upper corner system. No lengthM or anchor (box spans all pitches). Kept stored facts.
review.other_findings: One source lists the route as 8 pitches but its own pitch list runs to P8-10 (2-3 more pitches above P7). Another says the Direct ends beside the headwall pillar rather than climbing the headwall (King Kong does); stored overview says 'to a headwall finish'.
